item.title: Reijou no Kangoku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gash
  • 発売日: 2009-07-31
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 令嬢の監獄
  • 英語名: Reijou no Kangoku

あらすじ

Kyoya is now standing in front of a house. As a matter of fact, he and his mother was living there ten years ago, but they were kicked out of the house by Kanemitsu. After that, his mother passed away in poverty. Yes, Kyoya is now back to take revenge on them… Kanemitsu is already dead, but there are Masato, his son, Kotono, Masato’s younger sister, Mizuki, Masato’s fiancee, Mio, a maid and Sayoko, Kanemitsu’s second wife. While he pretends to be a good man outwardly, he entraps them one by one…

item.title: Doki Doki Rooming
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gash
  • 発売日: 2008-09-26
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Doki Doki る～みんぐ
  • 英語名: Doki Doki Rooming

あらすじ

One day, the main character receives a letter from his aunt. She is a caretaker of an apartment building and the letter says, “I’ve got badly injured, so please work as a caretaker for two weeks as a replacement for me.” When he reads it, he doesn’t want to accept it, but the letter also says, “There lives a lot of pretty girls and they’ll be waiting for you.” He finally accepts it and comes to the apartment…. However, the apartment building is very old. “It doesn’t matter! Pretty girls must be waiting for me!”

item.title: Tonarizuma 2 ~Inwaku no Keibou~
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2007-07-27

  • 日本語名: 隣り妻2 ～淫惑の閨房～
  • 英語名: Tonarizuma 2 Inwaku no Keibou

あらすじ

Takahiro works as a system engineer. One day, he accidentally finds a secret file at his client’s house. The file contains data on the client’s wife having sex with someone. From that day, his life dramatically changes… Rich and beautiful wives… Everyone has a secret aspect… His personality gradually breaks down…

item.title: Breed! Breed-Island.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gash
  • 発売日: 2006-07-28
  • スコア: 6.709999999999999/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ぶり～ど! Breed-island.
  • 英語名: Breed! Breed-Island.

あらすじ

The player takes the role of Jun, a young man that falls overboard from his ship during a storm, only to awake on an island that is inhabited by young women. While he initially thinks he is in heaven, it is revealed that he is the creature known as a “man” that is destined to arrive at the island once every generation to help all women of age to “create new life”.
